parsed.summary: The schematic is consistent with the specification: the CAN crystals Y1/Y2 are 16MHz (matching the board_TODO correction), the isolated CAN transceivers U10/U11 are paired with MCP2515 controllers U8/U9 and SM712-class TVS arrays D9/D10 on the CAN lines, the e-stop chain uses SN74LVC1G07 buffers (U15/U22/U35/U36) with ESTOP_OUT shared to J2/J13, the WS2812B chain D5-D7/D18-D21 is present, U6 is the LTC4412 ideal-diode controller with a P-MOSFET, and U5/U24 are ISL54222AIUZ muxes. The two things that initially looked off are not behavioral deviations: the COPI/CIPO net labels on U8/U9 and the CM4 SPI pins are swapped relative to the SPI-naming note but are swapped at BOTH ends, so MOSI still lands on the peripheral SI and MISO on SO (functionally correct, just a naming quirk the spec itself acknowledges); and the buffer U2 on the GLOBAL_EN path corresponds to the power-good/sequencing behaviour the spec lists as an open question, not a confirmed-working reference property. No deviation that would change board behaviour is supported by the drawing.
